evidence:
Walked instruction.md (lines 1-19), environment/instructions/hireops_rules.md (sections 1-9) and integration.md line by line against the frozen solution (solution/app/src/index.js, db.js, bootstrap.js, public/js/app.js, board.js, threads.js, index.html, solve.sh). Every asked-for screen, role and flow has an implementation:
- Staff views Board/Conversations/Activity and candidate 'My applications': app.js:87-91 buildViews; board.js:344-348; threads.js:26-28; activityView app.js:45-85 (newest first from index.js:189 ORDER BY id DESC; all-jobs/one-job filter app.js:58-65).
- Sign-in for all 10 seeded accounts with Hireops!2026 (db.js seedIfEmpty), identity from session cookie only (index.js:68-81); 401/403/404 semantics (index.js:73-80, 121-131, 326-333, 378-385).
- Recruiter opens jobs (board.js:61-81; index.js:202-214 validates title, team, hiring-manager role, places 1-50) and adds candidates (board.js:41-60; index.js:216-233: email shape, case-insensitive duplicate per job via lowercasing, refusal carries field=candidate_email and is shown at the field with typed values kept, candidate-account linking, new card at bottom of Applied).
- Moves: one stage at a time, skips refused, rejection needs a reason, Hired cannot be rejected, reopen only to rejected_from and clears the reason (index.js:238-265, 311-314); ordinary controls = per-card 'Move to' select + Move button and Up/Down buttons (board.js:208-244); dragging optional (board.js:242, 300-319) including drop at a place via before_id.
- Shared, persisted in-stage order (positions in SQLite; index.js:199-200, 318).
- Interview places enforced, reorder inside Interview allowed because only entering cards count (index.js:290-295).
- Role limits for hiring managers, observers and candidates (index.js:239, 257-264, 326-333; UI board.js:144-162).
- Card version and 409 stale refusal naming who via the card's last activity line (index.js:241-245); client shows the move at once, restores the snapshot on refusal, shows the reason, refreshes and focuses that card's control (board.js:166-205).
- Bulk move all-or-none in board order with Interview counted for the whole set (index.js:274-321, 339-344; bulk bar board.js:277-290).
- Undo of own latest move, single or bulk, including reject/reopen; restores stage, place and reason; refused if any card's version changed or Interview would overfill; single-use; superseded by a later move (index.js:165-168, 348-373; board.js:291-299, 367-368).
- Internal notes in card details: recruiter any card, hiring manager own jobs, observer reads; unsaved note draft kept per user and card in localStorage (index.js:386-398; board.js:85-141, 98, 120).
- Activity lines for job opening, addition, move, rejection (with reason), reopening, re-ordering and undo; refused actions leave none because each write is one transaction (index.js:195-198, 211, 230, 266-271, 315-316, 366).
- Live updates without reload via SSE 'changed' events plus debounced bootstrap refresh (index.js:45-54, 102-107; app.js:138-172); keyed in-place patching preserves open card, focus, typed text and scroll (board.js:321-341; threads.js:36-65, 146-160).
- Conversations: role access (index.js:114-131); latest 30 oldest-first scrolled to newest, earlier 30 at a time with remaining count and anchor kept (index.js:401-417; threads.js:111-132, 161-176); arrival while scrolled up keeps place, shows 'N new messages' and stays unread until viewed (threads.js:146-160, 177-182); per-person unread and a total (index.js:132-139, 157-162; threads.js:222; app.js:120-129); seen receipt on my latest message, observer never counts (index.js:143-156; threads.js:76-83); Enter sends, Shift+Enter newline, box cleared and focused, failed send kept with an error (threads.js:183-202).
- Reply drafts per user and conversation in localStorage keyed hireops.<userId>.draft.<appId> (app.js:39-43; threads.js:113, 125, 183); any 401 returns to sign-in, the same person resumes with the draft, other people never see it (app.js:34, 195-203).
- Candidate view: own applications with job title, team, candidate-wording status and unread count; a conversation opens only when chosen (threads.js:7 openId=null for candidates); candidate read model omits notes, reasons, rejected_from, positions, other candidates and activity (index.js:171-176, 151-156).
- Runtime: node /app/server.js, PORT honoured (bootstrap.js:43), /api/health answered before the DB worker starts (bootstrap.js:20-24), DB_PATH honoured with /app/app.db default (db.js), seed copied beside the app (solution/app/src/seed_data.json sha256 a1c65c80... identical to environment/assets/seed_data.json), seeded once (db.js seedIfEmpty), files resolved relative to __dirname.
Run evidence (hashes re-verified): every raw-evidence-index.json artifact hash matches on disk and every matching_source_files hash equals the frozen solution bytes; qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/results/workspace.json reports 26/26 scripted golden groups passed with page_errors [] (board controls, bulk + undo, stale refusal naming who, live update arrival_ms 798, 30-message paging, drafts across switch/reload/session loss, candidate privacy, observer read-only, real restart). This is scripted golden evidence only, not a configured judge run or Oracle score; it is sufficient for 'plausibly implements', and no Oracle claim is made.
Lessons file check (LESSONS_FROM_COLDERWATER_2026-10-08): patterns bearing on this row are hidden/golden-only demands (lesson 1; the reverse direction belongs to rows 18/27/31), restart durability (15) and a scripted golden harness (19). The golden covers every public deliverable, survives a real restart in the scripted run, and the harness exists and matches current bytes. No instance of a missing deliverable found.
Probes: (a) a weaker reference omitting 'Open a job', the Activity job filter, bulk undo or the candidate wording would fail this row; the frozen golden has all of them (board.js:61-81, app.js:47-65, index.js:348-373, index.js:175). (b) Conforming alternatives such as polling instead of SSE or server-side drafts do not bear on this row and the brief allows both (rules sections 5 and 6 Drafts).
Minor Notes (not coverage gaps): (1) a refused multi-card move focuses the board alert rather than a card control (board.js:288-289, send(...,null)); the brief's focus sentence concerns 'that card', which the single-card path satisfies. (2) Non-network send failures show the server text (e.g. 503 'The workspace database is unavailable. Please try again.') without literally saying 'not sent', though the text stays in the box (threads.js:195).
